name: growth-buddy-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper around the Growth-Buddy web app. Web code lives in ../Growth-Buddy; this repo only holds the native shells.

scripts.build:web: cd ../Growth-Buddy && npm run build && cd - && rm -rf www && cp -r ../Growth-Buddy/dist www
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
